_provenance.purpose: Real UK regional wind (onshore + offshore) installed capacity, used as CAPACITY WEIGHTS for sim/weather_weighting.py's capacity_weighted_wind_speed(). Built for item E of docs/design/PREMISE_FABRIC_PHYSICS_DISCOVER.md (director instruction 2026-08-03). This is the HIGHEST-VALUE half of that item: W1_7_renewable_capacity_trends already MEASURED a ~4.6-5.1x wind load-factor residual and diagnosed the mechanism as exactly this -- sim/price_engine.py's power curve is driven by a NATIONAL-MEAN wind speed, while real turbines are sited non-randomly in high-wind locations (Scotland, offshore). This file supplies the real siting weights that make a capacity-weighted alternative index constructible and checkable.
_provenance.source: DESNZ (Department for Energy Security and Net Zero) 'Renewable electricity - installed capacity by region 2003-2024', part of the Accredited Official Statistics publication Energy Trends, published alongside 'Renewable Electricity in Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and England in 2024'.
_provenance.published: 2025-09-30 (per the workbook's own Cover sheet); next publication September 2026
_provenance.sheet: MW2024 (the workbook contains one MWyyyy sheet per year 2003-2024; MW2024 is the most recent and the one used here)
_provenance.units: MW installed capacity at 31 December (workbook Note 2)
_provenance.offshore_attribution: Per the workbook's own Notes sheet, Note 4: 'Offshore wind is allocated to regions/countries according to where the cabling comes ashore' -- a real, stated allocation convention, not this atom's invention.

site_to_region_mapping.C3: Glasgow -- DESNZ 'Scotland' row (whole-country figure, no sub-Scotland split; matches the population file's same convention)

_provenance.resolution_honesty: Same 4-site constraint as the population file: each weight is an entire region-or-nation's total installed wind capacity attributed to ONE weather-archive site, not a site-local capacity figure. Scotland's real installed wind capacity (~14.4 GW) dwarfs the other three sites combined (~2.86 GW) -- this large real skew IS the point (it is the real-world siting-selection effect the W1_7 residual diagnosed), not a data error.
_provenance.never_fabricated: No weight in this file is invented, interpolated, or defaulted to uniform. Every figure is read directly from the fetched DESNZ workbook's MW2024 sheet.
